summary: Comprehensive regression testing of FormWise iteration 2 (mock passport page + shared React panel + progress tracker + chat). Backend: 6/6 pytest passing (form-help w/ new optional fields, form-help backward compat, chat, extension zip contents+manifest v2.0.0, /api/status returns 404, history). Frontend: /demo and /mock-passport.html both fully functional. All 11 field label detections on mock page matched spec exactly (givenName, boi_n, ms_single, nonEcr_y, street, mobile, emergencyName, emergencyMobile, gs_y, fatherName after AJAX). Progress tracker shows 4/18 initially and increments to 5/18 after filling givenName. Jump-to-field expands missing list, focuses field on parent page. Field help produces options-card and recommendation-box on option-btn click. Chat sends+receives, persists across reload via localStorage shim. Close panel removes 'visible' class. Landing page download links point to /api/extension/download. Mobile 390px viewport: panel fills full width, no layout breakage.
passed_tests: POST /api/form-help with section_context + help_text -> 200 with advice/warning
POST /api/form-help backward compat without new optional fields -> 200
POST /api/chat with structured page_context -> 200 with response string
GET /api/extension/download -> application/zip containing panel.js, index.html, content.js, config.js, manifest.json (v2.0.0)
Mock passport page: all 11 field detections match expected labels (givenName, boi_n, ms_single, nonEcr_y, street, mobile, emergencyName, emergencyMobile, gs_y, fatherName post-AJAX)
Mock passport progress-count: 4/18 initial, 5/18 after fill; toggle expands list; item click focuses parent field
Mock passport panel-loading -> options-card -> option-btn click -> recommendation-box
Mock passport chat: user message immediate, assistant reply within ~45s; persists across reload
Mock passport close-panel-btn removes 'visible' class from #formwise-frame

Demo page: click input-surname -> panel-question='Surname (Last Name)', panel-section='Applicant Details'; 0/13 -> 2/13 on filling given_name+gender; jump-to-field focuses input; tab-chat send/receive; close-panel-btn hides panel
Landing page loads; three anchors point to /api/extension/download
Mobile 390px: /demo panel bbox = 390x844 (full width, no overflow)
